verdict.rationale: Wave documents a double-entry ledger and says users can create 'unlimited... bookkeeping records', but nothing in the pack describes manual journal entries, entering balanced debits and credits, or attaching memos to an entry. Double-entry is the underlying ledger model, not the manual journal-entry capability this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
